summary.value: A prequel set a year before the main story. Yuta Okkotsu, a teenager haunted by the vengeful spirit of his childhood friend Rika, is taken in by Tokyo Jujutsu High to learn to control a power he never asked for.
Yuta finds his first friends among the school's other first-years, until a sorcerer who despises non-sorcerers announces an attack on two cities.

events.title: Yuta is spared and enrolled
events.detail: Instead of being executed, he is registered as a special grade sorcerer and put under Gojo's watch.

events.title: The first-years take him in
events.detail: Maki, Toge and Panda become his classmates and bring him along on missions.

events.title: The Night Parade of a Hundred Demons is announced
events.detail: Geto declares that on 24 December a thousand curses will be released in each of Shinjuku and Kyoto.

events.title: Yuta and Geto face each other
events.detail: The prequel builds to a showdown that decides what Yuta does with Rika's power.
